recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered collage set against a blue-lined graph paper background, featuring a mix of disparate objects including a carnival mask with confetti, a small black-and-white portrait, miniature furniture in a box, and stylized airbrushed rainbow arcs with stars.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-based background providing structural order to chaotic collage elements
Contrast between flat airbrushed graphics and three-dimensional photographed objects
Juxtaposition of patriotic motifs (stars/stripes) with theatrical and domestic items
Tight, heavy typography anchoring the top of the loose composition
coreInvariants: Heavyweight slab-serif or rounded-slab display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Elements are distributed across the grid; a large mask occupies the lower left, while a portrait and box occupy the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, black title text at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the rainbow arcs from the center-left toward the top-right, then drops down to the mask and across to the miniature furniture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The graph paper grid serves as active negative space, visible between all floating elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary red, blue, and yellow (Rainbow, confetti, and miniature box)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast black text against a pale, low-saturation background, with pops of high-saturation primary colors in the objects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight letter spacing (touching or nearly touching)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a tight, circular loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use the same heavy slab serif for smaller captions to maintain a unified, 1970s editorial feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, heavy, 70s aesthetic perfectly.
Offers similar weight and tight-fitting characteristics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution blue-lined graph paper background. Layer a collage onto it including: a pale theatrical mask with a black butterfly eye-mask and colorful confetti; three airbrushed rainbow arcs (red, white, blue) sweeping from left to center; a cluster of small black stars; a small grainy B&W photo of a man; and a yellow box containing two miniature chairs (one green, one red). Ensure objects have realistic soft drop shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the title text at the top center using an ultra-heavy rounded slab serif in solid black. Set the tracking to be extremely tight so characters almost touch. Add smaller captions in the same font near the relevant objects.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent blue-lined grid?
Is the typography extremely heavy and tightly spaced?
Do the collage elements have a 'cut-out' look with soft shadows?
Are the rainbow arcs airbrushed in style?

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is solid black and not distressed.
Ensure the grid lines are thin and light blue.
Verify that the airbrushing has a soft, grainy gradient.
Confirm the mask and objects look like physical items placed on paper.
recipe.reuseFormula: Graph Paper Background + Heavy Rounded Slab Serif + Airbrushed Arcs + Scattered Physical Objects = 70s Editorial Collage Style
